# Copilot instructions for MassFlow

Purpose: give future Copilot sessions repository-specific guidance (build/test/lint commands, high-level architecture, and important conventions).

---

Build, test, and lint (authoritative commands)

- Environment & deps (recommended):
  - uv is the supported environment manager. Install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
  - Pin and sync: uv python pin 3.13 && uv sync
  - CI-like full install: uv sync --all-extras

- Run full tests (CI):
  - uv run pytest
  - CI: uv run pytest --cov=src/MassFlow --cov-report=xml --cov-fail-under=80 -v

- Run a single test file or test: (examples)
  - uv run pytest tests/test_workflow.py
  - uv run pytest tests/test_cli.py::test_some_case

- Lint/Typecheck/format
  - Ruff lint: uv run ruff check .
  - Mypy typecheck: uv run mypy .
  - pre-commit exists (.pre-commit-config.yaml). Locally: pre-commit run --all-files

- Quick CLI smoke runs:
  - uv run massflow annotate --config massflow_config.yaml
  - uv run massflow db build --input <library> --output <out.db> --config <cfg> --category library

---

High-level architecture (concise)

- Config-first CLI: YAML -> MassFlowConfig -> run_annotation_pipeline(). Core entrypoint is src/MassFlow/cli.py which dispatches commands (annotate, init, db build/inspect/merge).
- Modular boundaries:
  - config.py: Pydantic config models and validation
  - io.py: file-system boundary, loaders/writers for mzML/MGF/MSP and SQLite libraries
  - processing.py: matchms-based metadata/peak pipeline
  - similarity.py: scoring engines (cosine, modified_cosine; experimental: spec2vec, ms2deepscore, consensus, cascade)
  - database.py: all SQLite interactions (build/inspect/merge) and triage_flags logic
  - workflow.py: orchestration, multiprocessing, chunked reference searching, FDR, export
- Stable vs experimental: prefer cosine/modified_cosine, CSV/mzTab-M, and SQLite DB workflows for v1.0. See README/ARCHITECTURE for details.

---

Key repository conventions (important, not generic)

- Use uv for env management and commands (uv.run ...). Avoid ad-hoc pip installs unless explicitly required.
- Target Python 3.13+. Tests and CI expect that version.
- Spectra must be represented as matchms.Spectrum objects; processing pipelines must preserve critical metadata (precursor_mz, retention_time, adduct, compound_name).
- m/z and intensities must keep float64 precision (do not cast to float32). Use NaN for missing scientific values, not 0.
- Variable names are explicit: precursor_mz, retention_time_seconds, spectrum_peaks. Avoid abbreviations except domain-standard mz/rt in comments.
- Database interaction rule: all raw SQL and schema changes live in src/MassFlow/database.py. Document schema/migration notes at the top of that file.
- Tests: add tests alongside any behavior change. Run the specific test file locally before pushing.
- Export filenames and CLI patterns follow documented patterns: <input_stem>_results.<ext>, and FBMN uses consensus_spectra.mgf alongside CSV.

Notes for Copilot sessions

- Prefer small, testable edits. Maintain readable code and NumPy-style docstrings for public functions.
- When proposing changes that alter DB schema, add a migration note at top of src/MassFlow/database.py and update tests covering the DB path.
- Respect stable vs experimental boundaries in user-facing suggestions.
